subject: english
question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom / Phrase.**

On account of
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Because of**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**On account of**" means "because of".
 
• "On account of" is used to provide the reason or cause for the picnic being cancelled and for missing the meeting.
 
• It's essentially a way of attributing a situation to a specific cause or reason.&
